scope_change_reason: The preceding audit shows the section error is strictly below (319/100) exp(-361), which is strictly below 2^{-361}. The named next step is the comparison with 2^{-380}.

stop_rule: Stop once (319/100) exp(-361) is compared with 2^{-380}. Do not form Q and do not compare a larger C.
